## PARAMETERIZED SQL ONLY

The query uses `$1 ... $23` placeholders and the Postgres node's
**Query Parameters** option (`options.queryReplacement`), which n8n
sanitizes. **No value is ever concatenated into the SQL string.**

This is a direct reaction to the documented anti-example
(template 14036: 41 nodes, string-built SQL in all 6 Postgres nodes,
zero error handling) - "what NOT to copy".

`options.queryBatching = "transaction"` -> all rows in this activity
land atomically or none do. That is what makes the activity safely
retryable by Temporal.

`ON CONFLICT (run_key, batch_index, record_ref, classifier_version)
DO NOTHING` makes a retry of the whole batch a no-op instead of a
duplicate (idempotency rule, sql/0034).

## GAP-031 UPDATE (2026-08-26, Claude Code · Sonnet 5)

This body now also accepts a per-item `adjudication` block
(`decision_id`/`actor`/`decision`/`reason`/`source`) from items that
passed the Temporal review gate (`server/temporal/
classification_workflow.py::_resolve_gate`). A SEPARATE partial
unique index on `decision_id` (sql/0034) is NOT the ON CONFLICT
target of this query, so a `decision_id` reused across two different
items raises a real Postgres error instead of silently landing twice
- the transaction batching above then rolls back the whole batch.
See sql/0034_classification_adjudication.sql for the full contract.

## TABLE `analysis.chunk_classification` IS NO LONGER A PLACEHOLDER

Landed live by sql/0033_chunk_classification_drafts.sql (Stage 5) and
extended by sql/0034_classification_adjudication.sql (GAP-031,
2026-08-26 Claude Code · Sonnet 5). ACTUAL columns this query writes:

```
run_key             text        not null   <-- pipeline run identity
batch_index         int         not null   <-- workflow/run identity
classifier_version  text        not null   <-- versioned-drafts rule
conversation_key    text
seq                 bigint
record_ref          text                   <-- item identity: chunk_id
                                               > record_id > record_ref
                                               (mirrors Temporal's
                                               ClassificationBatchPipeline
                                               ._item_key exactly)
occurred_at         timestamptz            <-- when it HAPPENED
message_text        text        not null
labels              text[]
sentiment           text
severity            int
summary             text
judge_verdict       text
judge_confidence    real
judge_model         text
classify_model      text
review_state        text        not null   <-- 'reviewed' iff adjudicated
-- GAP-031 adjudication provenance (sql/0034), NULL for straight-through items:
decision_id         text
actor               text
decision            text                   <-- approve|correct only
reason              text
source              text
adjudicated_at      timestamptz
unique (run_key, batch_index, record_ref, classifier_version)
unique (decision_id) where decision_id is not null
```

The row key includes `classifier_version` **on purpose**: a
re-classified corpus writes NEW rows. Old labels are SUPERSEDED,
never overwritten. Nothing here promotes anything - promotion is a
separate, human step.

## PLACEHOLDERS
- Credential **PLATFORM_PG (placeholder)** - type `postgres`.
  Read/write ONLY on the `analysis` schema. n8n stays **read-only**
  against evidence collections; it never writes `evidence.*`.
- Table name `analysis.chunk_classification` - LIVE, no longer a
  placeholder (sql/0033 + sql/0034); only the credential remains a
  placeholder to fill in at deploy.

## CANNIBALIZED FROM
- **native docs** Postgres v2.6 Execute Query + Query Parameters
  (Shape-7 rank-1 pick) and Query Batching = Transaction.
- **template 14036** used as an ANTI-example (string-built SQL).

INSERT INTO analysis.chunk_classification (
    run_key, batch_index, classifier_version,
    conversation_key, seq, record_ref, occurred_at, message_text,
    labels, sentiment, severity, summary,
    judge_verdict, judge_confidence, judge_model, classify_model,
    review_state,
    decision_id, actor, decision, reason, source, adjudicated_at
) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3,
    $4, $5, $6, $7::timestamptz, $8,
    $9::text[], $10, $11::int, $12,
    $13, $14::real, $15, $16,
    $17,
    $18, $19, $20, $21, $22, $23::timestamptz
)
ON CONFLICT (run_key, batch_index, record_ref, classifier_version) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, run_key, batch_index, record_ref, classifier_version, decision_id;
